notes: Provider list prices in FEE_TOKEN base units per 1M tokens (USDC.e on mainnet, D-035; 6 decimals, 1000000 = 1 USD). The relay charges list x (1 + relay_markup_bps/10000), rounded up to whole base units. Each entry names its source and the date it was read (checked). confirmed=true only when read from the provider's own public price list; confirmed=false entries block the release (pnpm --filter @sealed/relay release-check).

models.source_note: Tinfoil's public model catalog, which lists per-model API prices (https://tinfoil.sh/pricing: API access is pay-as-you-go with per-model pricing). Read from the rendered page on 2026-10-28; Tinfoil's public model list API https://api.tinfoil.sh/v1/models gave the same figures that day.
